LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_30be6b849d7a: Grechka World — the colony’s grand quest book
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_aa666e3d2ca7: A short route: read the rules → 80 steel → basic housing → T1 assembly bench → first component batch. Harvests, kitchens and decoration do not delay T2. Choose side branches to suit your colony.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_a4b5a60f3a6a: Manual and fueled workshops, basic defense and climate control. Choose useful buildings; the whole catalog is optional. The main T1 route is in Starting out.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_712aaaaae7c5: The main route is advanced component → advanced housing → T2 assembly bench. Workshops, power, utilities and defense are optional branches. You do not need the entire factory for T3.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_c8d5711051eb: Turn resources into parts, materials and medicine. Choose chemistry, mechanics or recycling. Each machine is an independent optional objective.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_4f9a504ca722: Soup, grilling, baking, condiments and canning are independent food routes. Pick one and leave others for later. Rice harvesting does not unlock this chapter or delay industry.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_df9aca91623c: Start with generation and storage, then choose options suited to the map and fuel. You do not need every generator. Solar progression is in Power.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_c5f700dbdafe: An optional Generator branch. Available ARC parts and your scenario determine the route. These are alternatives; rewards do not require building every ARC in sequence.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_f35d4ba544a0: Refrigeration, heating and controlled growing serve different needs. Choose suitable storage size and climate control; you do not need every model to continue.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_13d20ccb71e9: Trade, scanning, transport, doors and fire protection support industry and are optional before T3.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_4f71c254ca28: Work lighting and relaxation after a shift. Decorative lighting and recreation are independent choices for your layout.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_cea46f01bbcb: Two separate branches: mechanitor and genetics. Specific operations depend on your colony and DLC. Neither is required for T3.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_79ceef810066: Independent defense options. Choose range and special weapons for your threats and layout. They are not a mandatory chain.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_9a34c5149895: Concrete production and several fortification families. Choose mobile guns, bunkers or heavy positions. This entire chapter is optional for industrial tiers.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_7a4e4a15dfec: An optional factory with real processes: raw input → selected production line → product. Drilling, textiles, chemistry, food and medicine are parallel routes.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_3b310035b0d8: Vanilla Plants Expanded, VGP More Veggies, Farming and Fishing. Harvests count separately from purchases. Fish objectives check stock rather than an unverified catch event.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_55a8b6937b84: Vanilla Nutrient Paste Expanded. Grinder, tank and consumers form an independent food network. Storage quartz cable does not replace paste pipes.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_422f1f7f4a3c: Misc. Robots, More Linkables and VFE Production. Free pawns from hauling and prepare convenient workshops.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_9a6a8e49597c: Quartz → silicon → processors → network and disks. Build a working storage network first, then expand capacity.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_5856c9eb5a6e: The controller shows recipes from connected benches. A crafter serves neighboring benches in turn; patterns are unnecessary.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_4a614d9822d7: Mechanites, an independent crystal farm and colony infrastructure. Pawns still tend mechaponics.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_f98d0ce34137: Archotechnology unlocks matter and emitters. High speed needs an appropriate power system.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_6a3a42dd6979: Buckwheat ore completes the main industrial ladder. Expensive automation begins here; your colony continues.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_7ee31d0a5944: Grechka armor, weapons, drones and bionics. Owning an item does not mean implanting it or equipping a pawn.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_0d60b3fe4a0a: VFE Power and Grechka’s solar ladder provide independent power routes. Late panels require previous stages.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_eba37eb2d6ac: VFE Medical and Grechka bionics. Equipment, medicine stocks and prosthetics are separate tasks. The book does not perform surgery.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_2e083ff60ecf: Vanilla Psycasts Expanded. Collect eltex and equipment. Psycaster development follows the original mod. The book awards no levels or abilities.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_687404d10e5f: Pirates, The Generator, Cryptoforge and other adventures. The storyteller schedules events. This book tracks material trophies rather than completing other mods’ stories.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_848850e4baa0: Vanilla Books Expanded and Misc. Training. Colony development also needs books and training.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_8ee4abef72c0: Spacer, Neat Storage and Fridge. Optional living quarters, workshop and storage objectives. Every item remains yours.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_a2ac12ddc312: Optional production records. These branches do not block progression. Locked objectives also accumulate progress.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_3341daaebeaf: Optional records with lucky blocks. Colony kills and slaughter count only with the tracker installed; found corpses do not count. Old save history cannot be reconstructed.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_9ad5fc8b900c: All research is completed in a new Grechka World. Materials, components and housings determine machine availability. The book takes no items and unlocks no recipes. Locked quests track objectives in advance; rewards follow predecessor quests. The default book hotkey is 5 and can be changed in settings. Read and check the objective manually.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_eb344f363f63: A basic housing needs 80 steel and 4 regular components. Mine, buy or use starting steel. Claim four components as the reward and proceed to the housing.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_3f363c08711b: Optional branch. Harvest 30 rice when your colony is ready. Industry does not depend on this objective; you do not need to wait for crops to reach T1 or T2.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_d7f4eae6e63f: Build the basic assembly bench using a T1 housing, 60 steel and 2 regular components. It makes regular component batches, advanced components and T2 advanced housings.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_44a3ab932a78: A basic housing requires 80 steel, 4 industrial components and crafting 4. Make the first housing at a crafting spot. For later housings, use the same spot or any T1–T5 assembly bench. A crafting spot can also make one component from 12 steel.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_5061f7f336db: Make one component batch at the assembly bench: 60 steel → 5 components before machine bonuses. Larger batches are optional milestones and achievements.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_a729471b0730: At a T1 assembly bench, combine a T1 housing, 40 steel, 20 plasteel and 4 advanced components. Crafting 6 required. This housing offers many machines; the book does not require them all.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_af5c9035f464: The advanced assembly bench costs a T2 housing, 80 steel, 4 regular and 2 advanced components. Upgrade an existing T1 in place. It unlocks mecha components, mecha housings and early improved solar panels.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_c229ab85be5d: Make the first advanced component at a T1 assembly bench; T2 is unnecessary. Then prepare four for the advanced housing. Buying helps subsequent recipes, but this learning objective tracks production of one component.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_66abca4038ae: Mine 30 quartz from veins. Quartz can also be bought or found in mineral meteorites, but this objective requires mining.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_3dd79a227ce4: Makes quartz, silver and gold processors. No presses or patterns required. Select a recipe and prepare silicon wafers and materials. This begins Storage electronics. Minimum T1 housing in Grechka World. Optional branch; higher tiers do not require every variant.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_0c0f2a788a48: Make 8 quartz processors. Check intermediate recipes: quartz dust and silicon are needed for wafers.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_4640b89252ac: Build a 1×1 controller for storage, disks, devices and autocrafting. Underground quartz cable carries signals; provide power separately. Extra controllers add no channels; this network has none.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_8cb098e1c8ff: Build a 1×1 disk block, connect signal cable and insert a disk through the controller. Each disk supports 63 item types and size-dependent capacity, preserving item properties. This objective checks the building, not network operation.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_586f4aae5219: Have a 1K disk. Request intake through the controller; pawns physically haul items in and out. Normal disks retain food decay, freezing disks freeze food even in caravans. Optimization redistributes items by disk size.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_289c85a86bdb: Find a world-map meteorite event and send a caravan. Bring certus quartz and a portable crystal source home, then surround the source with accelerators. This objective checks quartz ownership, not visiting the event.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_90114ed7122a: Build and power the extractor. It obtains material from a parallel dimension. No gas chain is needed.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_b26e5a443a4b: Power the extractor and collect the first 25 mechanites for one mecha component. No gas, solution or manual refining required.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_b7ac216867c9: At the T2 assembly bench combine 4 advanced components, 20 plasteel, 10 uranium and 25 mechanites. The first item teaches the recipe; later stocks serve your machines rather than the quest counter.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_d95b0473d3e0: Build T3 mechaponics: ×5 growth, 500 W, no light or nutrient solution. Pawns sow and harvest. T4/T5 grow faster and draw more power.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_7eac2a0ad190: The ionizer lights and cleans the entire room, removing dirt, blood and tracks. Build and power one in a working room.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_e9d7da9eaa6b: Place a 1×1 crafter beside benches and connect quartz cable. It serves up to four neighbors one cycle at a time. Crafter tier controls worker speed; bench tier controls its production bonuses.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_9b6e62f8a9bb: Open controller autocrafting to see real connected recipes. Order an item, inspect missing materials and set minimum stock. Mark manually; the book does not automatically treat an order as completed.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_8c180da1517d: Synthesize the first unit of archo-substrate. Starting the process matters, not extra batches. Found or bought material works in recipes, but this objective requires synthesis.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_ec816e524cca: Make the first archo-component using previous-tier materials and archo-substrate. It serves T4 housing, equipment and late power. Large batches are unnecessary for this learning step.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_2bf9b9e1f785: Build a T4 archo-generator for constant power without fuel, breakdowns or cooling. Long matter chains need more power.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_184f9879a4df: Obtain the first 10 matter from the generator, then feed a synthesizer. This branch is optional for the buckwheat component itself.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_2a74e66a9ad1: Mine the first 10 buckwheat ore. The whole vein is unnecessary. Refine it into concentrate and the final buckwheat component.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_65fcf125079e: Refine the first buckwheat concentrate from ore. This prepared T5 resource serves components and late machines.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_ce0953869b81: Make the first buckwheat component. Choose what to accelerate next: production, storage, mechaponics, emitters or power.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_72e0a9a12833: Build the final S6 panel. The chain starts with vanilla solar panels and uses previous stages. Aim for one per late base or three with matter production; actual demand depends on machines.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_cb5a177274d9: Obtain T3 armor. Equipment spans T3–T5. Top-tier golden wings are a separate compatible visual item.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_aa56f55d4f30: Obtain a cryorifle. Base damage is 100 per bullet, burst size 10 and fixed range. Bursts do not introduce a separate magazine system.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_dda61500b6c2: Obtain a T4 combat drone and equip it in a utility slot. It attacks near its owner. The objective checks possession, not combat score.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_1e23df07031c: Obtain a T4 mythical arm with 300% efficiency. T5 buckwheat equivalents give 600%. Surgery follows human anatomy; other bodies need compatible adapters.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_7ff99eeeeaaf: Different chip families coexist. A higher tier replaces the previous tier of the same family and returns the removed chip as an item. Fast raiders may carry combat chips when the storyteller selects their event. The book does not verify surgery or victory.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_ee7334ec6193: Optional milestone: produce 100 advanced components while the book is active. Old stock is not retroactively production.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_3ab0bc5e4b5a: Optional possession goal: 100 quartz processors, bought or crafted. Network disks also count in supported inventory tracking.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_1bc10ffad4ea: You completed the main industrial chain. Build your own system, scale matter and tune stock levels. Transfer the book as JSON; author mode lets you create chapters and rewards.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_cfd0235677b5: The drill obtains resources through its own process. Check deposits and power, then prepare output storage. Minimum T2 housing. Optional branch; building every variant is unnecessary for the next tier.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_100bcc3f1d35: The hopper supplies ingredients to adjacent equipment. Configure filters and check actual adjacency. Minimum T2 housing. Optional branch; every variant is unnecessary for the next tier.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_bc6195043e27: Build three conveyor segments and plan their direction. The book counts your buildings.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_61b31913a7ce: Recovers metal from suitable input and unwanted items. Choose a recipe and inspect output before processing valuables. Minimum T2 housing. Optional branch; every variant is unnecessary for the next tier.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_ce860910aae8: The assembler produces items through its own process. A Storage crafter can later supply it from disks.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_84a3e3197c1c: Converts suitable organic material into chemfuel. Arrange input and output to supply generators and transport. Minimum T2 housing. Optional branch; every variant is unnecessary for the next tier.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_0b87f6e5a97d: Produce 250 chemfuel through regular recipes or supported factories. Hauling and buying do not increase the counter.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_ad09ab440290: The alloy furnace is the next metallurgy step. Open its processes and arrange ingredient supply.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_921950669c18: Produce 200 plasteel. Bought stocks help construction but do not replace achievement production.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_a158dccf562a: Build a neutroamine synthesizer. Its output connects chemistry and medicine.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_75a35c95ad82: Produce 100 neutroamine through a supported Factory process. Trading remains available, but this is a production milestone.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_60ce07e6331c: Prepare a medicine granulator and recipe materials. Neutroamine serves more than trade.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_5f0b01dab3fc: Produce 100 industrial medicine. It remains yours for the next raid.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_0d2f7385ad3d: The textile machine runs its own processes. Choose textiles and supply ingredients. Minimum T2 housing. Optional branch; every variant is unnecessary for the next tier.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_fd4decde0ad8: Produce 100 hyperweave through the Factory loom for clothing and equipment batches.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_bfe94d43d939: The autofarmer serves its working strip. Check direction, growing zones and harvest output; owning it does not mark the whole field. Minimum T2 housing. Optional branch; every variant is unnecessary for the next tier.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_de51abae306b: Automatic fish farming supplements regular fishing. Prepare your own food chain.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_9522ea4f17e5: Cooks large soup batches. Compare batch size with stock and colonists, then maintain a food reserve. Minimum T2 housing. Optional branch; every variant is unnecessary for the next tier.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_8f905fe954c2: Stock 10 finished simple soups. Unfinished preparations do not count.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_873dc56f49a9: Adds grilled meal recipes as an alternative to a stove. Choose ingredients for your colony. Minimum T1 housing. Optional branch; every variant is unnecessary for the next tier.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_d03b346656a3: Cook or buy ten simple grill meals. This checks finished stock, not meals eaten.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_339f04f37673: Prepare ingredients for baking recipes. Flour and additives connect it to other kitchen production. Minimum T2 housing. Optional branch; every variant is unnecessary for the next tier.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_73917175096c: Stock 100 flour and inspect Bakery recipes. Bought flour counts.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_20a86d1ed90d: Twenty simple confections deserve a celebration. The quest will not eat them.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_0129a509981f: Make canned food for storage and transport using available ingredients and recipes. Minimum T2 housing. Optional branch; every variant is unnecessary for the next tier.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_d0cc3e58c8f1: Stock 30 canned vegetables. Consume this reserve after reaching the objective if desired.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_4d2abe37e944: An independent kitchen route with its own recipes. Choose ingredients from your stocks. Minimum T1 housing. Optional branch; every variant is unnecessary for the next tier.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_305d276f1dbc: Stock ten fine stews. Trading counts too.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_57f95f9cb989: Produces food additives including ketchup. Keep a small stock near the kitchen. Minimum T1 housing. Optional branch; every variant is unnecessary for the next tier.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_aad4adc88d0a: Fifty ketchup. There is no practical need to finish this objective; that is the point.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_fc36c45a3adb: Serves nearby growing plants. Place it according to actual coverage and provide power. Minimum T2 housing. Optional branch; every variant is unnecessary for the next tier.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_4d15373b5edb: An artificial ecosystem offers another growing option alongside mechaponics.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_0aaff250676e: Vanilla Plants Expanded: harvest 100 apples from plants. Purchased fruit is not a harvest.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_24a57b6e0773: Harvest 250 VPE tomatoes. VGP tomatoes have a separate branch; definitions are not merged without an explicit rule.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_f609b27d29d0: VGP More Veggies: harvest 100 carrots. This plant branch does not require Factory.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_94838d03b011: Grow and harvest 100 VGP avocados. Found fruit does not increase the counter.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_d2ac8a88f26f: Vanilla Fishing Expanded: stock 30 salmon. This checks stock; catching and buying both count.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_af0bc9f793f8: Stock 15 each of tuna, cod and trout. Objectives latch separately; the fish can then go to the kitchen.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_ef0ffb9673e1: Part of the paste network: grinders make paste, tanks store it and consumers dispense it. Connect pipes. Minimum T2 housing. Optional branch; every variant is unnecessary for the next tier.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_cbee7e3a7cf6: Lay five hidden pipe segments. This is a separate network; power uses regular wires.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_f285ea94fdf0: Misc. Robots: install a basic hauling station. The robot and charging follow Misc. Robots rules.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_36182f4fe0cc: Place a cleaning station. This helps with regular dirt before the Grechka ionizer.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_7e82685c86ed: Makes weapons and mechanical items. Choose needed equipment and supply the crafter. Minimum T2 housing. Optional branch; every variant is unnecessary for the next tier.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_2709ad5a4c25: A mechanic’s cabinet helps a compatible nearby workplace. The objective checks the building, not whether its bonus is active.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_9ccb0b350b65: Processes chunks into building blocks. Store input nearby to reduce hauling. Minimum T2 housing. Optional branch; every variant is unnecessary for the next tier.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_bcae10cb4168: Turns cloth and leather into apparel. Select material and quality in bills and start with needed equipment. Minimum T2 housing. Optional branch; every variant is unnecessary for the next tier.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_2244ffd4a4fd: Makes concrete for fortifications. Start with a batch for a specific project and use it for chosen defenses. Minimum T2 housing. Optional branch; every variant is unnecessary for the next tier.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_a366a83ac2b2: Stock 500 concrete blocks. Spend them on the perimeter afterwards; reached objectives stay complete.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_19dc65cdf4a1: Makes reinforced barrels and mechanical parts for selected guns and defense production. Minimum T2 housing. Optional branch; every variant is unnecessary for the next tier.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_82d94f79f667: Smelts scrap into steel. It produces substantial heat; provide a suitable room. Minimum T2 housing. Optional branch; every variant is unnecessary for the next tier.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_507a32f91dd0: Produces chemfuel for generators and other consumers. Maintain useful stock beyond the quest. Minimum T2 housing. Optional branch; every variant is unnecessary for the next tier.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_9b3b2771642b: A fortified position combines protection and weapons. Check crew requirements, access and firing direction. Minimum T2 housing. Optional branch; every variant is unnecessary for the next tier.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_be51a5f3c451: Long-range defense. Check ammunition, minimum range and safe firing areas. Minimum T2 housing. Optional branch; every variant is unnecessary for the next tier.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_340055d310b4: Provides its mod’s communication or recreation functions. Place it where colonists can use it. Minimum T2 housing. Optional branch; every variant is unnecessary for the next tier.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_e5edb8738f2c: Combines trade beacon and mech control relay. Inner coverage serves trade; outer coverage serves control. May attract orbital traders. Minimum T2 housing. Optional branch; every variant is unnecessary for the next tier.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_ea7adf6c41e7: VFE Power: an advanced battery smooths intermittent generation.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_eb519c97c9f7: An advanced turbine is an alternative between solar stages. Leave adequate open space.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_600899045f66: The VFE Power reactor is an independent power route. Solar is one option among several.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_33d5a15d9c5d: Start from a vanilla solar panel and build the first improved stage. Old panels become materials for new ones.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_af544b9c3924: The next panel needs several previous panels. Prepare a dedicated solar-cell order.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_4ac99f96f1be: This stage combines components and T3 solar cells. Stock materials before dismantling your active power plant.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_ba14008d3612: Build the next stage from six previous panels. Solar now tests your entire production throughput.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_e65ee3e183d0: The archo stage consumes six previous panels. Plan components, housings and solar cells for the buckwheat finale.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_0725772c9b56: An optional Storage branch uses digital network materials alongside the main solar ladder.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_a6e0cf2c703b: The Fortifications panel connects solar power to that mod’s industry.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_81e1328a01f2: VFE Medical: prepare an operating table. Surgery is unnecessary for this objective.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_512e272bf0d6: Serves medical beds. Check its connection; a standalone monitor does not replace a doctor. Minimum T2 housing. Optional branch; every variant is unnecessary for the next tier.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_ab4579c3a6c0: Keep 50 industrial medicine. The book takes none.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_bf974a4b7dfd: Harvest 100 herbal medicine as an independent farming milestone.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_9368c9be95bc: Twenty glitterworld medicine provide serious insurance. Purchases and trophies count.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_33d2c8df674e: Vanilla Psycasts Expanded: obtain 25 eltex by mining or trade, depending on events and available merchants.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_e0409dc26f4b: Prepare an eltex mask. Owning it grants no abilities and does not require equipping it immediately.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_412a3f62e5b5: The Eltex panel connects Grechka’s psychic and power branches.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_3bcfeddbad60: Builds heavy warcaskets around a selected pawn. Prepare materials and consider the consequences for that colonist. Minimum T2 housing. Optional branch; every variant is unnecessary for the next tier.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_7f3cc8582b3f: Find, buy or craft a Pirates warcasket minigun. Heavy fighters need heavy weapons.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_2b063a27afcb: The Generator: collect 10 ARC components. The original mod controls story events and acquisition conditions.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_c619ddcd7725: An ARC generator variant. Compare conditions and costs to an existing ARC. This is an alternative power configuration. Minimum T2 housing. Optional branch; every variant is unnecessary for the next tier.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_ee61038fe395: Cryptoforge: obtain a cryptoaxe. Found, bought and crafted weapons all count.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_aa536e44ae43: Add a cryptobolter to the arsenal. The book does not start or finish Cryptoforge events for the storyteller.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_4465d179cb08: Creates books. Choose a subject and author for the colony library. Minimum T1 housing. Optional branch; every variant is unnecessary for the next tier.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_3360230bbc5e: Obtain a crafting book. This checks the item; reading and learning follow Books Expanded rules.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_2fdda7f44abc: Add medicine, construction and cooking books. Each is tracked separately, then can be read or sold.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_abc1285614c0: Misc. Training: place a shooting target. This quest does not increase skill itself.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_133de07cbb12: Add a melee target. Train before a real fight.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_9ed9d330a328: Keeps perishables near workplaces. Choose size and placement to suit the site; other fridges are unnecessary. Minimum T2 housing. Optional branch; every variant is unnecessary for the next tier.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_d3cf8aa295fb: Spacer: a repair shelf extends equipment life. Check allowed items in its settings.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_8ff5c07fadd0: Place a Spacer large screen. It gives no next-tier housing but makes the base a home.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_896afacf4c15: Non-Lethal: obtain a rubber-bullet pistol. Its intended role does not guarantee every target survives.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_75b625810ef1: Add a Non-Lethal dart gun. This checks the weapon, not capturing a pawn.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_397aabbe9f8a: Silicon connects quartz and processor chains. Stock it before large disk orders.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_ec9b8bb762de: Produce twenty silver processors. Buying is allowed, but this objective tracks your own production.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_a43f794bfa88: Produce twenty gold processors for complex network devices.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_cf8ea22a34fa: Install a certus source on your map. Obtain it in a meteorite expedition and transport it as a device.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_3662c2fba715: Place two accelerators near the farm. This counts devices; check coverage when placing them.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_cf27db3c0f31: Prepare a disk of this capacity. Each still supports 63 types. The objective checks an accessible disk item; claim it before insertion into a block.

LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_458708296b77: There are two independent routes here. For cleaning and hauling, buy a Misc. Robots station with its robot, or craft one later. For rescue and defence, craft Grechka docks at T1–T5 assembly benches. Biotech mechanitors are a third, separate system. The companion drone in Equipment is wearable gear, and the Storage crafter is a stationary machine. They do not replace these robots. Choose a job and follow its route; mark this introduction manually.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_0254fb2c0260: The shortest route to a first hauler or cleaner is to buy a base station: the robot is included. Check robot and exotic traders; stock is random and the station you want is not guaranteed. Orbital trade needs a comms console and trade beacon; ground trade does not. Crafting becomes available later through Fabrication and Biotech Basic mechtech. The next two branches are alternatives; you do not need both.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_21520c0953c6: An optional purchasing route. Research Microelectronics, then build and power a comms console and orbital trade beacon. Put silver in beacon coverage and wait for a suitable ship. Base station market values are 2350 for the hauler and 1950 for the cleaner; your actual price depends on trade modifiers. You can wait for a ground trader without these buildings. This objective checks installed devices only, not a purchase or trader arrival.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_5a3943da1b1a: This is an alternative to buying. In the installed Misc. Robots 1.7, station recipes inherit Fabrication and Biotech Basic mechtech, require Crafting 9 and use the fabrication bench (FabricationBench). Basic mechtech belongs to the Biotech mechanitor route; Grechka Robotics T1 does not replace it. If research requirements are disabled, check the bills available at your bench. Prepare these requirements and mark this step manually: the book does not verify research.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_a8010e38a9e6: A fabrication bench for household robots
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_ee99e8262c56: Build a fabrication bench (FabricationBench) for general industrial production; T3-T5 variants also count. Craft Misc. Robots++ robots only at Grechka assembly benches: each needs one housing of its own tier, a bench of that tier or higher and the metal shown in the recipe. Cleaner, hauler, kitchen, crafter, builder, ER and Omni bots are available at T1-T5. Matrices, their components and the separate Robotics workbench are hidden. A simple cleaner or hauler needs 20 steel, one T1 housing and Crafting 4. This is an optional branch: an assembly bench is sufficient for robot crafting.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_4c504570ddb7: Buy OR craft a hauler or cleaner station. Select the packed station and install it beside your power grid; the robot is included. Each charging station requires 250 W. Either type completes this junction, without requiring both acquisition routes. The objective checks an installed station, not a packed item or an active robot.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_366f789445fa: Install a hauler OR cleaner station
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_3987dfd31b96: The Misc. Robots hauler moves items but does not work at benches. Buy a station or craft one. Order a hauler I at a Grechka T1 assembly bench: it needs 20 steel, one basic T1 housing and Crafting 4. No matrix is required. Higher-tier robots use a housing of their own tier and an assembly bench of that tier or higher. Install the station, supply 250 W, activate the robot and allow storage areas and hauling routes. This objective only checks the station.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_6964f142cdcb: The Misc. Robots cleaner removes dirt but does not craft items. Buy a station or craft a cleaner I at a Grechka T1 assembly bench: it needs 20 steel, one basic T1 housing and Crafting 4. No matrix is required. Higher-tier benches retain lower-tier recipes. Install the station, supply 250 W, activate the robot and allow the desired rooms. The cleaner is independent of the hauler, so you can start with it. This objective only checks the station.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_2cd394ebf75e: Deploy and configure your first robot
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_db7bc572e6eb: After installation, select the station, check power and deploy the robot. Set its allowed area to include both its station and its work: dirty rooms for a cleaner, or stockpiles and items for a hauler. Check paths and forbidden doors. Without eligible work it may idle; when low on energy it needs an accessible powered dock. Observe the chosen robot actually working and mark this step manually. You do not need to buy a second robot.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_8fdcdb2e9425: Your own drones: start at assembly T1
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_8d28bda631da: You do not need a household robot to make rescue or warrior drones. In the Start chapter, follow: 80 steel → basic housing → T1 assembly bench. Build and power this bench; higher tiers also count. Grechka docks are crafted through assembly bench bills, then installed from the finished package. These independent robots do not need a mechanitor.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_4c6329bf9815: Build an assembly bench T1 or higher
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_5545f61e53fe: Materials for your first rescue drone
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_d597224a6f10: Prepare a rescue dock T1 kit: 1 T1 basic housing, 100 steel, 10 plasteel and 4 industrial components. Make the housing at the starting workstation; buy plasteel or produce it industrially. A warrior T1 needs 20 plasteel and 6 components with the same housing and 100 steel. The book records possession without taking anything. Only the actual dock recipe consumes resources.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_174c13d7bc02: If Grechka World research is enabled, research Industry T1 and Microelectronics, then Robotics T1 on the Grechka tab. It unlocks both T1 docks. Grechka recipes at the T1 assembly bench do not require Fabrication or Basic mechtech. If the pack research setting is disabled, go straight to the bench bill. This is a manual readiness check, not automatic research detection. Rescue and warrior are alternatives by role; you do not need both.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_b117424b4b38: At the T1 assembly bench, open Bills and add a T1 rescue dock bill. Recipe: 1 T1 housing + 100 steel + 10 plasteel + 4 industrial components. Crafting 7 is required. Wait for the packed station; its drone is included. If the recipe is hidden, check Robotics T1 and the type of bench. Mark crafting manually; the next node checks the installed dock.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_a30b3441edaf: Install the finished rescue dock T1, supply 250 W and deploy the drone through the station. It rescues downed friendly pawns and helps with fires; enemy capture is a separate toggle. Allow paths to casualties and the hospital. The book checks the installed dock; observe its first real job yourself.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_7fb89a8525cd: At the T1 assembly bench, open Bills and add a T1 warrior dock bill. Recipe: 1 T1 housing + 100 steel + 20 plasteel + 6 industrial components. Crafting 7 is required. Wait for the packed station; its drone is included. If the recipe is hidden, check Robotics T1 and the type of bench. Mark crafting manually; the next node checks the installed dock.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_a2e69735fa20: Install the finished warrior dock T1, supply 250 W and deploy the drone. Allow its defence area and a path back to the dock. The warrior defends and patrols; it is not a cleaner or crafter. It retreats for repairs when badly damaged. This objective records the installed dock, not a battle victory.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_eed6bf125510: Every drone needs a path to its own powered station. Rescue T1 docks use 250 W; warrior T1 docks use 250 W. Higher tiers need more power. Check allowed areas, doors and eligible work. Our docks repair a living drone but do not resurrect a dead one. Inspect the chosen drone, power and settings, then mark manually. Reaching T2 does not require damaging a drone or building both roles.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_393688181eed: Follow the main industrial route to the T2 assembly bench. With research enabled, complete Robotics T1 and Industry T2, then Robotics T2. With research disabled, use the available recipes and materials. The T2 bench crafts a new complete dock with its drone; a previous dock is not an ingredient. Choose rescue or warrior. Mark preparation manually; both previous-tier docks are not required to continue the book.

Install the finished station, supply 400 W and deploy its included drone. A hauler, cleaner or previous-tier dock is not an ingredient. The objective checks the installed dock of this tier; check charging, allowed area and behaviour after deployment.

Start by obtaining a mechlink through Biotech events and see T2: mechs, genes and recovery. Basic mechtech is also required by the installed household Misc. Robots recipes, but independent Grechka docks T1–T5 do not need a mechanitor. Mark this reference step manually; it does not gate either main route.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_1c6e06cf61c0: Cut your first gemstones, make precious weapons and recover a monolith for your own treasury. Weapons and the color collection are optional branches. The colony keeps every objective item; visiting a site is confirmed manually only. Requires Grechka Treasures.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_0ed42c93ed5f: I have read the treasure-hunting rules
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_a03ad8d9c2f2: Grechka Treasures adds diamond, ruby, sapphire, emerald, amethyst and topaz. Find rare veins, trade and explore caches. Quest objectives never consume items or unlock recipes. If research is enabled, study jewelcraft; the default Grechka World mode makes the recipes available without research. Read this introduction and confirm manually.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_9afd2b928af8: Have 3 uncut gemstones of any type
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_02176ef97fdd: Obtain three uncut gemstones of any of the six types. Mining, purchases, finds and rewards all count; different types are summed. Veins yield uncut gems, while a large monolith is a separate rare find. You keep the stones.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_b4536e0eef68: Build a jeweler's bench using 100 steel and 60 wood. It works without electricity. Its bills cover cutting gems, sawing monoliths, weapons and carved art. Cutting and weapons use Crafting; statues and vases use Artistic. An existing owned bench also counts.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_99efdda66979: Produce four cut gemstones of any type at the jeweler's bench: one uncut stone becomes one cut gem. This counts actual production after activating this book, not purchases or moving stock. A cut diamond becomes a brilliant. The rewarded map opens the separate expedition branch.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_64667b5cbfad: Optional branch. Produce one precious weapon: a knife, sword, spear or mace of any gem. A brilliant knife needs four diamonds, 30 steel and 8 gold. With research enabled, study gemsmithing first. The objective checks production, not equipping it or winning battles; you keep the weapon.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_a0991ff4260e: Optional branch. Collect two cut rubies, two sapphires and two emeralds. Each color threshold is recorded separately. Buy, find or cut them. Diamond improves armor penetration, ruby strengthens blows, sapphire increases durability and emerald is especially beautiful. This collection does not block expeditions.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_f9d1336ffb59: Obtain a treasure map. The first cutting quest already rewards one; more can be bought from exotic traders or found in genuine chests. This is a possession objective: the map need not have been read yet. The next step explains how to use it.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_92450838a839: I deciphered the map and saw the treasure site
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_54a22eb3e105: Place the map on the ground, select a colonist and order them to decipher it with the right mouse button. The mod consumes the physical map only after finding a site; the quest does not consume it. Up to four sites may exist; discard an unwanted unvisited lead on the world map. The book does not automatically track reading: confirm manually once the site and letter appear.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_0d21525e9fdf: I visited a treasury and returned with loot
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_5fc3a48a1854: Prepare a caravan and visit a treasure site. Read the clues: a shiny chest may be a decoy, the real cache may hide behind a side wall, and raiders or mechanoids may be waiting nearby. Carry out everything you need before the last pawn leaves: the temporary map closes. Manually confirm the visit and return with loot. The automatic item objective checks only that you own a cut gem, not where it came from.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_5d786332a854: A crystal for a whole wagon
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_b7dce5d5c2ca: Obtain an intact monolith of any gemstone. The expedition reward supplies your first training ruby monolith. It weighs 45 kg, so plan caravan capacity. Carve it into a solid statue or saw it into 30 cut gems. The book takes nothing; keeping this monolith is useful for the next step.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_dba0d557c62c: Have an installed precious statue or vase
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_86f3122dfb6f: Make and install any precious statue or vase. A statue costs one monolith and 80 gold; a vase costs eight cut gems and 20 gold. These bills use Artistic at the jeweler's bench. The objective checks a completed, installed work in the colony; bought or found art also counts. You keep the item.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_af01268a0eff: Build or install at least one precious furnishing: a throne, table, bed, sarcophagus, obelisk or lamp of any color. The throne works as a chair, the bed improves rest, the lamp uses 20 W and the sarcophagus really stores a body. Vases and statues were covered separately. There is no need to build the whole catalog: choose what suits your colony.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_da9e115717db: Grechka Pharmacy: from dressings to T5
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_916b569a0cfe: Five pharmaceutical tiers: first aid → drug lab → mechanites → archotech serums → Grechka regeneration and rejuvenation. Follow the top route from left to right, with short practical branches below. Objectives never take preparations or require injuring pawns.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_e726d897475d: Prepare 8 Last chance dressings. Craft, buy or find them; all remain with the colony. At a crafting spot or drug lab, 2 herbal medicine and 4 cloth make 4 dressings. A dressing reduces bleeding by 85% for 3 hours, without replacing lost blood or healing wounds. It buys time to reach a hospital.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_b05bd8d37aaa: Produce 8 recovery solutions; purchases do not count. One drug lab batch uses 3 industrial medicine and 4 neutroamine to make 3 solutions, requiring Intellectual 5. For one day, natural healing is multiplied by 1.75 and hunger increases by 20%. Missing body parts are not restored. Your preparations are not taken.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_7dab7f292f9d: Build a pharmaceutical reactor T3 or above in the Grechka tab. It occupies 3×2 cells, needs a worker and 1200 W, and has ×5 work speed. In Grechka World it costs one T3 housing, 4 mecha-components, 120 steel and 120 plasteel. It makes T1–T3 preparations; higher reactors also make their own tiers. It is a workbench, not an autonomous factory: a pawn or Storage crafter must perform the recipes. Existing T4/T5 reactors also count.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_841cbe185e31: Produce 2 limb regeneration serums at a T4/T5 reactor. In Grechka World each uses 3 glitterworld medicine, 20 neutroamine and 8 archotech substrate, requiring Intellectual 12. It restores one missing natural limb or external limb segment and adds one day of enhanced recovery. Heads and torsos cannot be restored; implants and psychic sacrifices are protected. Only production is checked; no procedure or deliberately injured pawn is required.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_a3c55fab89b1: Produce 1 Grechka regeneration serum at a T5 reactor. In Grechka World it uses 5 glitterworld medicine, 30 neutroamine, 10 archotech substrate and 10 Grechka concentrate; Intellectual 14 is required. The one-day course heals fresh injuries by up to 5 points per hour and one old scar or supported chronic condition. It neither regrows limbs nor resurrects; implants, genes and special conditions remain. Only production is checked and you keep the serum.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_199e45b5be59: Pharmacy adds special consumable preparations; ordinary medicine is still used for tending and surgery. In a new Grechka World game, research is completed by default. If vanilla progression is enabled, study the five Pharmacy tiers in the Grechka research tab. Quests explain the mod without taking items to unlock recipes. The five top nodes form the main route; practical branches introduce every preparation. Read this and press Complete.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_a25bc0227c2e: Make 4 dressings: 2 herbal medicine and 4 cloth yield 4 dressings. Even a crafting spot works, with no skill requirement. Unlike the possession objective above, this checks production. Higher reactors retain early recipes, so the primitive workbench can later be removed.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_6a599363be6f: Make 4 field analgesics from 3 herbal medicine. The preparation reduces pain by 55% for 6 hours without healing the injury itself. A pawn may remain standing despite dangerous wounds, so watch blood loss and vital organs. One batch completes the objective; no healthy pawn needs to take it.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_2de2821cb65b: An able pawn can be ordered to use a preparation. For a bedridden patient, schedule administration in the health tab and provide an available doctor. Doctors hide useless targeted procedures, such as limb regeneration without a suitable missing limb. In version 0.1.0, manually ordered self-administration can waste an unsuitable serum. Repeating the same effect extends its duration without stacking bonuses. This is a reading step: press Complete; no patient experiment is required.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_84aa72225b40: Prepare a drug lab. It makes T2 preparations, which can later be produced at any pharmaceutical reactor. In Grechka World, the lab uses T2 housing; higher-tier lab variants also count. Buy neutroamine or produce it with the VFE Factory synthesizer. Industrial medicine remains a separate production chain; Pharmacy does not replace it.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_e5b82f5a2508: Make 3 immune support preparations: 6 neutroamine and 3 herbal medicine yield 3 doses, requiring Intellectual 5. They increase immunity gain speed by 50% for one day. This supports the body during illness; it neither prevents new infections nor instantly removes an existing one. One batch completes the objective; administration is not checked.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_68849d79b678: Make 1 Clean slate course from 4 industrial medicine and 8 neutroamine, requiring Intellectual 5. The one-day course gradually treats one ordinary chemical addiction. It does not remove luciferium dependency, genetic dependencies or tolerance. Repeating a dose during a course does not provide instant extra treatment. No addiction is required for this quest; only production counts.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_1cd9c48013ca: Produce 2 Living tissue injectors at T3 or above. In Grechka World a batch uses 6 industrial medicine, 10 neutroamine and 6 mechanites, requiring Intellectual 8. The one-day course performs up to 24 steps, each healing up to 2 points of one fresh injury. It does not repair scars, missing parts or bionics. One batch is enough for this lesson.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_ac285a319af4: Make 2 combat injectors. In Grechka World: 8 neutroamine, 2 yayo, 2 industrial medicine and 6 mechanites; Intellectual 8. For 8 hours: movement ×1.25, shooting accuracy ×1.1 and pain ×0.3, followed by 6 hours of fatigue. It is temporary combat preparation, not a substitute for armor or treatment. Administration is not required.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_22b1a3ef0ab3: Make 2 work concentrates. In Grechka World: 8 neutroamine, 2 wake-up, 2 industrial medicine and 6 mechanites; Intellectual 8. For one day, global work speed is ×1.35 and rest consumption ×0.5, followed by 6 hours of fatigue. Useful before major construction or rebuilding; repeated doses do not stack work speed.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_1e997e146861: Plan for the end of the shift
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_cc66264b0e26: Combat and work stimulants are followed by 6 hours of fatigue: work ×0.8, movement ×0.9 and rest consumption ×1.5. Different preparations may act together; repeating the same one extends its duration without stacking multipliers. Plan work during the active period and allow time for recovery. Press Complete after reading; there is no need to wait for fatigue in game.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_cd341cd7b94b: Build a pharmaceutical reactor T4 or above. In Grechka World: one T4 housing, 8 archotech components, 160 steel and 160 plasteel. The T4 version occupies 3×2 cells, uses 3000 W and provides ×12 work speed. It retains early recipes and adds glitterworld medicine synthesis, scar repair and limb serums. A T5 reactor also counts.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_154d9adfb2e3: Synthesize 1 glitterworld medicine at a T4/T5 reactor. In Grechka World, 2 industrial medicine, 4 neutroamine and 1 archotech substrate yield 1 medicine; Intellectual 12 is required. Standalone Pharmacy without Industry uses 1 gold instead of substrate. This completes the supply chain for late serums without mandatory purchases. Bought medicine does not count toward this production objective.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_e5b6ffcb47c2: Produce 1 scar repair serum. In Grechka World: 2 glitterworld medicine, 15 neutroamine and 4 archotech substrate; Intellectual 12. It removes one permanent natural-tissue injury and adds one day of enhanced recovery. It does not replace installed bionics or cure every condition at once. No scarred patient is required.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_000a6323dbe1: Build a pharmaceutical reactor T5. In Grechka World: one T5 housing, 12 Grechka components, 200 steel and 200 plasteel. The 3×2 building uses 8000 W and has ×25 work speed. It retains all earlier recipes and adds Grechka regeneration and rejuvenation. Supply steady power and ingredients; a pawn or connected crafter performs the work.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_6c885fdb30ff: Make 1 youth renewal serum at T5. In Grechka World: 5 glitterworld medicine, 30 neutroamine, 10 archotech substrate and 15 Grechka concentrate; Intellectual 14. It reduces a humanlike pawn’s biological age by 5 years, never below 25 or the race’s adulthood age. Chronological age is unchanged. Younger pawns receive no benefit. Only production is required.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_0dcf00f39910: You have covered all 12 preparations and your own glitterworld medicine chain. The medical supplier and Zero Shift sell preparations, while Storage can supply actual workbenches through its existing autocrafting. Purchases help stockpiles; production lessons count manufacturing. No quest requires harming anyone or consuming serums. Claim the rewards from all practical branches, then complete this final reading step.

LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_22b1f7d0bcf5: Gather your first 40 steel for the workshop: mined, bought or starting stock all count. The book takes nothing. Continue to 80 steel → basic housing → assembly T1 → components. Research is completed in a normal new Grechka World colony; when progression is enabled, also check technologies. Locked goals already track progress.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_11a0e3dfe24f: Produce 5 industrial components after installing the book update. For automation, connect the bench to the controller, place a crafter beside it and set a minimum stock; no patterns are needed. The automatic counter confirms new recipe output, including manual production. Purchases and transfers do not count; controller use is not separately verified.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_b3854b390243: A first chip for a colonist
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_fa25df45a26a: Obtain one Grechka chip by crafting or buying it. Any listed family and T4/T5 counts. Different families are compatible; a higher tier replaces a lower one and removal returns the item. This objective automatically checks the item, without requiring or pretending to verify implantation.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_4f70074b5d62: Build the final production setup: install a T5 crafter and a matter generator T4 or T5. The preceding solar and component routes remain required. Your buildings are detected automatically; efficiency and order setup remain up to your colony.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_68ae4b5f8174: Prepare 100 steel for robotisation. Then choose a job: Misc. Robots clean and haul; Grechka rescue drones rescue and help with fires, while warriors defend. Biotech mechanitors, wearable companion drones and stationary Storage crafters are separate systems. Choose the route you need; both are not required.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_9a8a32a17d7f: Stock 4 industrial components for crafting a station or maintaining your robot. Buy a station from robot or exotic traders OR craft it; the robot is included. Orbital purchases need a console and beacon, ground purchases do not. Stock is random; buying does not require the crafting branch.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_b76fd3c01354: Prepare 20 plasteel for further robotics development. Tier-I robots use 20 steel and a T1 housing; higher-tier housings and robots need plasteel. Each robot requires one housing of its own tier and a Grechka assembly bench of the same or a higher tier. Matrices and their production are disabled. Check the recipe for research and skill requirements. Buying a complete station lets you skip crafting preparation.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_d38a915fca4f: Install and power a station, then deploy its cleaner OR hauler. Allow an area including its station, paths, stockpiles or dirty rooms. This objective automatically checks a living player robot deployed on a home map outside its dock; packed units, corpses, foreign robots and prisoners do not count. It does not claim to verify completed hauling or cleaning.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_623f1e416d64: Produce 1 component of tier T1 at an available assembly bench: industrial for T1, advanced for T2, then mecha, archo and buckwheat. This is new production; buying or moving an old component does not count. Craft docks at the T1 assembly bench; with research enabled, complete Robotics T1 and its prerequisites. Previous-tier docks are not consumed; rescue and warrior roles are independent.

LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_d296a0bd7d31: At the T1 assembly bench, open Bills and add a T1 rescue dock bill. Recipe: 1 T1 housing + 100 steel + 10 plasteel + 4 industrial components. Crafting 7 is required. Wait for the packed station; its drone is included. If the recipe is hidden, check Robotics T1 and the type of bench. Crafting the finished kit counts automatically from a completed recipe. Buying or installing an old station does not count; the next node checks the installed dock.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_29bd13120d3c: At the T1 assembly bench, open Bills and add a T1 warrior dock bill. Recipe: 1 T1 housing + 100 steel + 20 plasteel + 6 industrial components. Crafting the finished kit counts automatically from a completed recipe. Buying or installing an old station does not count; the next node checks the installed dock.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_ce8d94b651ff: Deploy a living rescue or warrior drone from its powered dock; any tier T1–T5 counts. The objective automatically detects your drone deployed on a home map outside the station. Set its work area and return path. Both T1 docks use 250 W; higher tiers use 400/650/1000/1500 W. Docks repair living drones but do not resurrect dead ones. Repairs and specific jobs are not separately verified.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_f278a45c55f4: For the separate Biotech route, build a mech gestator and a basic recharger. You need a mechanitor mechlink and Basic mechtech when research is enabled. This route is optional for independent Grechka drones. The objective automatically checks the two buildings, not a mechanitor or a gestated mech.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_75528cea154d: Prepare 20 cloth and 4 herbal medicine for your first medical production. Special drugs do not replace all tending and surgery supplies. The book automatically checks your stock without consuming it. With research progression enabled, also research pharmacy tiers.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_c6ffd1e8dc99: Stock 4 haemostatic doses and 4 painkillers. Items count automatically; you do not need to medicate a healthy colonist for the reward. Order capable pawns to take a dose, or schedule administration through Health for a downed patient with an available doctor. Repeating an effect extends its duration without stacking bonuses.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_5324eb55427d: Prepare 4 recovery doses and 5 industrial medicine for recovery after a dangerous shift. No need to induce fatigue or cause harm for the quest. Combat/work stimulants are followed by 6 hours of fatigue: work ×0.8, movement ×0.9, rest consumption ×1.5. The objective automatically checks the prepared items only.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_51706709e400: After completing the practical routes, prepare a reserve of 10 glitterworld medicine and 1 buckwheat serum. Stock is checked automatically and may be crafted or bought; earlier production quests still require actual output. The book consumes nothing and does not demand surgery for rewards.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_d8d2fc8173ae: Prepare 100 steel for your jewellery setup and future expedition. Find veins of the six gems, trade and explore caches. The book consumes nothing and does not unlock recipes; jewellery research is needed when research is enabled. The reward requires an actual steel stock.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_a1c6b200819d: Prepare 10 packaged survival meals and 5 industrial medicine. Then place the treasure map on the ground and order a colonist to decipher it. Successful site creation consumes the map through the mod action, not the quest. Up to four sites may exist. This objective automatically checks supplies only, not map reading.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_016ea054c9fe: Obtain one large crystal monolith and at least one cut gem. Expeditions are a main source of these trophies: decoys may hide traps and defenders, and temporary maps close after departure. The objective automatically checks the items, including purchases; it does not claim to verify a particular visit or caravan return.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_a98cb6b87f09: A short route: first 40 steel → 80 steel stock → basic housing → T1 assembly bench → first component batch. Objectives are checked automatically and have rewards. Farming, cooking and decoration do not delay T2; side routes are choices for your colony.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_fdb9c0a1a19e: Start at “Robotisation: steel stock”. The upper route covers Misc. Robots haulers and cleaners: buy OR craft. The lower route covers crafting Grechka rescue and warrior drones T1–T5. Every objective is checked automatically and has a reward. Roles are independent.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_HopperFactoryUntiered: The Factory hopper has no tiers and requires no housing. A new hopper has an empty filter: open Storage and allow the required resources. For the drill's Dig for metals output, allowing everything is the simplest option; steel must be allowed at minimum. An empty filter or one that rejects the result blocks delivery even when progress reaches 100%.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_HopperVanillaUntiered: The hopper has no tiers and requires no housing. It stores ingredients for the adjacent nutrient paste dispenser. Configure its filter for suitable food; legacy tiered hoppers remain functional. This is an optional branch.

LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_Balance_04a43bfa58e0: At a T2 assembly bench, combine 1 advanced component, 8 plasteel, 4 uranium and 10 mechanites before machine bonuses. The first unit teaches the recipe; further stock supports the machines you choose, rather than an arbitrary quest quota.

LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_Balance_95e01d685db1: Manufacture 8 recovery solutions; purchases do not count. One drug-lab batch uses 3 industrial medicine and 4 neutroamine to produce 4 solutions; Intellectual 5 is required. For one day, a dose multiplies natural healing by 1.75 and hunger by 1.2. It does not restore missing body parts. Finished medicine remains yours.
LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_Balance_625bfc781f81: Manufacture 3 immune boosters. A batch uses 6 neutroamine and 3 herbal medicine to produce 4 doses; Intellectual 5 is required. LanguageData.GrechkaQuests_Pack_Balance_6f2783449322: Manufacture 1 Clean Slate dose. A batch uses 4 industrial medicine and 8 neutroamine to produce 3 doses; Intellectual 5 is required.
